current_position: P0/P1/P2完了。P3の前処理・POD作業配列・条件推論と保存の容量対策を実装受入。P4ローカルwheel受入完了。P5整理・文書・ローカル検査完了。実運用規模・物理用途とリモートCIは残る。SDK統合は後続。

implementation.preprocessing: Observed finite checks and shifted block population moments with bounded nditer buffers. No whole float64 observation gather; transform preprocessing moved into encoding batches. Existing mask/per-channel/eps semantics preserved.
implementation.data: Public slices preserve NumPy views; internal contiguous integer partitions borrow slices; public integer arrays retain gather semantics. Masks are not reordered for identity sample ordering. IDs/conditions/masks align.
implementation.pod: Owned Fortran float64 dense work matrix centered/weighted in place; former PCA second centering retained without copy. Existing scipy direct/sklearn randomized SVD and signs retained. Projection energy reduced by batches. Incremental consumes owned batches without extra IPCA copy; channel access is lazy.
implementation.streaming: FieldSurrogate.iter_predict yields ordered field or field/lower/upper batches; array APIs allocate final result directly. Coefficient, point and interval APIs use a common default query schedule. No new saved attributes or YAML optimization knobs.
implementation.output: Existing output.prediction_name extension selects npz or npy. NPY uses final-shape header and sequential batch writes; IDs/bands/metadata sidecars generated automatically. NPZ compresses staged NPY files with bounded RAM. Failed prediction batches do not publish partial field artifacts.
implementation.persistence: New plain POD basis/mean state does not require fit-only sklearn version. Persisted sklearn estimators and existing legacy bundle requirements remain enforced.
implementation.cleanup: Removed redundant full-array copies, full channel stack, unused modred helper, duplicate statistics/shape checks and weak incremental 5x-error test. Added independent moment/PCA/low-rank/physical-overflow/stream-output oracles where needed.

new_findings.finding: Finite coefficients can overflow when inverse preprocessing restores physical units
new_findings.resolution: Check each restored physical field batch and reject non-finite success; meaningful regression retained.

new_findings.resolution: One shared coefficient/point/band schedule; point array equality accepted. Arbitrary caller batch shapes can still round differently.

new_findings.finding: PCA second centering prevents spurious rank from rounded physical mean at large offset
new_findings.resolution: Retained in place while removing wrapper copies.

new_findings.finding: Unifying pod_svd onto SciPy loaded another BLAS and worsened private memory/time
new_findings.resolution: Kept original NumPy SVD; no unsupported capacity improvement claim.

new_findings.finding: Equivalent K8 direct/randomized candidates changed winner within approximately 1e-16 score differences
new_findings.resolution: Recorded near-tie separately from K1/K8 clear winner; final RMSE difference 2.8e-16 and coverage equal. No epsilon selection contract added.
